Format Utilization Results as Visual Tables

Source: R/tableUtilization.R
tableUtilization.Rd

Format Utilization Results as Visual Tables

Usage

tableUtilization(
  result,
  estimateName = character(),
  header = c("strata", "estimate"),
  settingsColumn = character(),
  groupColumn = character(),
  rename = character(),
  type = "gt",
  hide = character(),
  columnOrder = character(),
  factor = list(),
  style = NULL,
  showMinCellCount = TRUE,
  .options = list()
)

Arguments

result

A summarised_result object.

estimateName

Formatted estimates pattern, e.g. c("Mean (SD)" = "<mean> (<sd>)").

header

Columns to place in table header. Default: c("strata", "estimate").

settingsColumn

Settings columns to include. Default: character().

groupColumn

Group columns. Default: character().

rename

Named vector of column renamings. Default: character().

type

Output format: "gt", "flextable", "reactable", "datatable", or "tibble". Default: "gt".

hide

Columns to hide. Default: character().

columnOrder

Order of columns in table. Default: character().

factor

List of factor orderings. Default: list().

style

Table styling name or object. Default: NULL.

showMinCellCount

Whether to suppress counts below threshold. Default: TRUE.

.options

Additional formatting options. Default: list().

Value

A formatted table object or tibble.
